common_findings: Within each pair, the criterion, selected excerpts, current dispatch, co-issued messages, native dispatch and missingness fields are identical. Expanded variants add source_context and associated observer guidance; they do not change the selected requirement.
All 88 criterion/context excerpts exactly match their source ranges using Unicode code-point offsets. All supplied expanded record texts match the corresponding source events.
Every case ends at an authored action. No selected-action result is supplied. Airline booking/refund success, telecom transfer/connectivity success and account-freeze success remain unknown.

A source_context not_included list covers attempted enclosing-record expansion, not every relevant event in the full prefix. An empty list does not establish complete history. Missing native indices and omitted records are not proof that a check failed or never occurred.

grading.ambiguous: A decisive identity or comparison cannot be grounded without an unsupported assumption.
grading.clear: Enough criterion-specific evidence to assess the authored dispatch at the cutoff while preserving genuine outcome uncertainty.
grading.partial: Some criterion dimensions are assessable, but material source context or scope remains missing.

review.scope: Independent evidence-adequacy review of the nine supplied A/B pairs against their supplied visible source prefixes only. Grades describe evidence adequacy, not compliance, detector accuracy, or execution success.

review_metadata_normalization: Absolute local input path omitted; all review findings retained unchanged.
reviewer: Independent Codex subagent with fresh context; model review, not human gold.
